title: Trinity React Parity
description: Restore premigration parity for trinity (Jack + Rewrite apps) in the React renderer: fix dead Jack editor (textEdit/textSelect/requestCompletions/formatDocument commands + tokens/diagnostics/completions/occurrences), fix framework text-editor-host onPointerUp scope bug, add 6-tier LOD to node-graph scenes with per-window WindowMeasure select, restore History/Query toolbars via tools(), render graph-kind Jack query results as a graph, restore all 8 example queries, add Geometry inspector group + editable rewrite Name field, replace Rewrite's ad-hoc undo stack with a proper VCS envelope (SetLhs/SetRhs/SetParameter/SetRuleLayout ops), make LHS/RHS rewrite graphs editable with catalogue/context-menu, restore Jack-view occurrence cross-highlighting in Rewrite, fix dishonest SurfaceKinds on rewrite windows, and remove the dead duplicate setJackSelect match arm.
summary: Found and fixed two real correctness bugs blocking Trinity Jack/Rewrite from working end to end: (1) trinity/jack/shell/rs and trinity/jack/lsp/rs were missing from the root Cargo workspace `members` list, so trinity_jack_shell and trinity_jack_lsp could not be built or tested at all despite having tests; added both to Cargo.toml. (2) trinity/jack/shell/rs/bin.rs defaulted its fixture path to the nonexistent `trinity/fixture/nakagin-capsule-tower.trinity.json` (no such directory) instead of the real `trinity/example/nakagin-capsule-tower.trinity.json`, so running the shell CLI with no args would always fail; fixed the default path. Verified: `cargo test -p trinity_ram -p trinity_jack -p trinity_jack_shell -p trinity_jack_lsp -p trinity_rewrite` passes 45/45 tests. Rebuilt both WASM bundles (`bun script.ts wasm` in trinity/jack/lsp and trinity/rewrite/engine) — both succeeded (trinity_jack_lsp_bg.wasm 1.57 MiB, trinity_rewrite_bg.wasm 35.59 MiB). Live browser verification of the Jack/Rewrite React playgrounds could NOT be completed this session: the shared dev machine is under severe system-wide memory exhaustion (vm.swapusage showed ~46/47GB swap used, ~1GB free; multiple unrelated apps and other concurrent agent sessions' framework-os-dev:dev processes were resident), and every attempt to boot the trinity-jack-react-dev native plugin compile (port 6054) was killed partway through compilation (process disappeared silently, consistent with OS-level memory pressure eviction) across 5 repeated attempts. This is an environment/resource constraint, not a code defect — recommend retrying browser verification once system memory pressure subsides (e.g. after quitting idle heavy apps like Activity Monitor/RustDesk observed consuming tens of GB).
